name: Felucca: Aswan to Daraw (1 Night)
inclusions: Private transfer from your cruise, hotel, airport, or train station to the felucca
Three meals per day (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) and mineral water
note:
Super Deluxe Felucca Cruises
Sail along the Nile in style aboard an exclusive felucca, offering a blend of tradition and comfort. Relax as you glide through the river, enjoying stunning landscapes, birdwatching, and peaceful moments on the water. Our felucca is equipped with a hard sunroof that doubles as a sundeck, a toilet with a shower, comfortable long mattresses, pillows, and extra sheets. There is ample space for luggage storage, ensuring a comfortable and memorable experience.

Breakfast Menu:
Cheese, Boiled or scrambled eggs, Jam, Bread, Tea or coffee.
Nubian Lunch/Dinner Menu:
Aubergine or vegetable tagen, Chicken, meat, or Bamiya (okra) tagen, Rice, pasta, and a variety of salads, Egyptian bread, Soft drinks and water, Fruits, tea, or coffee. (Tagen is a traditional Nubian stew prepared with tomato and onion sauce, served in a clay pot.)

Price: 1 Person: $190 | 2-4 Persons: $260 per group | More than 4 Persons: $60 per additional person.

days.title: 1 Night / 1 Day Aswan to Daraw
activities: Since feluccas rely on the wind, there is no fixed schedule. The itinerary is tailored to your preferences.
10:00 – Depart from Aswan and sail downstream throughout the day.
Meals are served either onshore or onboard.
Evening: Gather under the stars with a campfire, traditional Nubian music, and dance performed by the captains and crew.
After reaching Daraw, continue your journey by car or minivan either to Luxor or back to Aswan.
